text:
evan-quant: quick flag — after the ql7b-int4 rollout we see a nontrivial dip on the rerank golden (overall -4.7%). latency OK, but ranking precision down.

ben-eng: do we have concrete examples? can you paste the top 1-2?

evan-quant: yup, shortened: 
```
prompt: 'Explain how the new refund clause affects recurring subscriptions.'
baseline(ql7b): 'The clause prevents auto-renewals after 30 days for X, and requires Y notice.'
ql7b-int4: 'Might stop renewals. unclear on notice and exceptions.'
```
outputs look blurrier, fewer grounded spans.

ada-ops: routing note 12:00-14:00 we had ~3% prod traffic on ql7b-int4, then paused on alerts. no customer incidents.

tori-qa: ran a quick label regression check on 200 golden items — saw ~18 items where predicted top answer changed category. some look like tokenization shifts around hyphens/quotes.

ben-eng: hmm. last time similar noise came from mismatched BPE merge tables at export. evan, what tokenizer does the model declare?

evan-quant: model artifact says bpe_table: bpe_v3_fused. our eval harness uses bpe_v3 (non-fused). so there's likely a serialization mismatch — fused merges produce different token boundaries.

sara-ml: that matches a lot of cases where multiword contractions get split differently and attention always shifts. can we do a shim that loads the model's bpe table at eval time?

evan-quant: yes 12 we can re-export a tiny tokenizer shim (handles fused merges) and re-run the golden. I'll label the build ql7b-token-shim:v1.

labelops-bot: Tokenization parity job queued for golden subset (n=1500). ETA 5h. Priority: P1.

ada-ops: infra plan: i'll stand up a pinned-tokenizer canary cluster (image: registry.redwood/ql-token:shims-v1) and route 4% traffic. cold-start metrics will be captured.

ben-eng: we should also check dedupe/noise in the golden that might amplify drops. labelops, any flagged duplicate buckets?

labelops-bot: Dedupe bucket Z contains 190 near-duplicates. Estimated relabel time: 14h (2 labelers). Suggested micro relabel first.

tori-qa: propose micro-golden of 120 samples selected by influence (i'll compute a shapley-lite per-example influence on rerank metric). if >30% of micro flips due to tokenization, we escalate relabel.

evan-quant: i'll produce the influence scores and push top120.json to https://internal.redwood/eng/ql7b/token-influence/top120.json once parity run completes.

ben-eng: order of ops: 1) run tokenizer-shim parity on golden subset; 2) compute influence, pick micro-golden; 3) run micro-golden human QA; 4) if metric restores, proceed with broader canary using pinned tokenizer; 5) if metric still down, start dedupe relabel.

ada-ops: starting cluster prep now, no traffic until we confirm shim build.

labelops-bot: notifying @labeler-team for micro-golden queue. human ETA for micro QA: 6h after samples posted.

sara-ml: note: watch long-context (>2048 tokens) and structured outputs (lists) — earlier quantized variants had more trouble preserving enumerations. log those separately.

tori-qa: quick manual spotcheck of 30 items from early parity run: 16 token-only diffs, 9 real output differences, 5 ambiguous/golden-label issues.

evan-quant: thanks. I'll prioritize making the shim deterministic and add a small regression harness that tokenizes both ways to highlight shifts.

ben-eng: owners: shim + parity run - evan-quant; micro-golden selection + influence - tori-qa; infra canary - ada-ops; relabel ops - labelops-bot. Update thread when parity job finishes or if micro flips > threshold. :thumbsup:
